# .NET Version Upgrade Progress

## Overview

Upgrade ContosoUniversity from .NET Framework 4.8 ASP.NET Framework/System.Web to ASP.NET Core targeting `net10.0`. The plan uses a side-by-side migration so the old Framework web application remains available while the new Core project is scaffolded and migrated.
